WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(spatial_count) AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count::numeric) AS avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.fundflux AS source,
       sc.spatial_count AS count,
       sc.spatial_count::numeric / t.total_count AS share,
       sc.spatial_count::numeric - t.avg_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts sc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE sc.spatial_count > t.avg_count;
